Family Day Class of 2030
From file to your hands
How your keychain was made

The same digital workflow we use for crowns, guides, and models in our clinics. Liquid resin is hardened by light, one very thin layer at a time.

1
Design
Modeled in 3D software with the class year and the DCG logo
2
Print
Built layer by layer on thin supports that hold it in place
3
Wash and cure
Rinsed clean, then hardened under light
4
Finish
That part is up to you, today
Family Day Class of 2030
Your turn
Three steps to make it yours
Step 1
Remove the supports
No tools needed. Use your fingers to snap the keychain off its supports. Save the flat raft at the bottom; you will practice on it.
Step 2
Add the strap
Pass the thin end of the strap through the small loop on the corner, then pull the strap through itself to lock it on.
Step 3
Engrave the base
Practice first on the raft with the handpiece and a small bur (#2 or #330). Once you have the feel, engrave the base of the keychain. Smooth rough spots with sandpaper.
Family Day Class of 2030
Eye protection on,
the whole time

Glasses first, before the handpiece starts, and for everyone at the table, not only the person engraving.

Hold the keychain flat against the table and keep your fingers away from the bur.

Light touch. Let the bur do the work; pressing harder only makes it skip.

Children engrave with an adult guiding their hand.

Stop the handpiece before you set it down or pass it to someone else.

Not sure? Raise your hand and one of us will come help.
